title: ICG vs Blue Patent for TAD in cN1 Breast Carcinoma After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy
official: ICG vs Blue Patent as a Tracer in the Performance of TAD in Patients With cN1 Breast Carcinoma After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy
summary: To validate the use of ICG as a tracer during TAD in patients with cN1 breast carcinoma after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

interventions.name: Targeted axillary dissection (TAD) by Blue patent

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Breast cancer cN+ patients who undergo neadjuvant treatment.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients in whom there is a contraindication for the use of ICG.
* Patients in whom there is evidence of progression of the disease after neoadjuvant treatment.
